subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's waited-reply artifact suppression boundary as the narrow fix for message-tool mirror duplicate delivery?
rationale: The patch is source-backed and well-proven, but it intentionally changes which transcript rows can cause visible A2A follow-up delivery, so the final risk tradeoff belongs to maintainers.

options.title: Accept The Narrow Dedupe Boundary
options.body: Land after a clean refresh if maintainers agree the QA Gateway proof is enough for this message-delivery boundary.

options.title: Ask For Live Transport Proof
options.body: Require a redacted WhatsApp or comparable live transport run showing one requester-visible reply after the duplicate window.

options.title: Consolidate A2A Duplicate Work
options.body: Pause this PR and fold the mirror, reverse sessions_send, and compaction duplicate roots into one maintainer-owned A2A plan.

recommendation.title: Accept The Narrow Dedupe Boundary
recommendation.body: Land after a clean refresh if maintainers agree the QA Gateway proof is enough for this message-delivery boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest recent history across run-wait helper contracts and A2A/sessions helper direction.
